lessons: Dogfooding win: instantiating progress/harness-config.json in the self-repo is exactly what flips INV-3 from inert to active here — before F36 the guard's `[[ ! -e ]]` new-file branch meant the threshold guard protected nothing in the harness's own repo (the most self-modification-prone context). Absence of runtime state is now itself detected by completeness.sh.

Test-field mismatch pattern: when a probe splits a marker phrase into `.name` and the variable detail into `.description`, negative assertions must filter the field that carries the marker. Filtering the wrong field yields a tautological test that passes against a regressed probe — precisely the kind of false-evidence the harness's 'evidence over claims' thesis exists to reject. Flag any `select(.<field> | test(...))` assertion whose target phrase is not in that field.
